answer: Prayers & Duties >> Oaths & Vows Question ID: 153842 Country: india Title: Please advise how can we keep promise Question: Last year something happened I promise Allah that I will do every good deed to please Him. I promised not/to watch TV and not listen to music and not click photos but I don’t know how I became misguided due to some sins I do after that I stop praying and break all this promises and I was continuously depressed that time that Allah will not happy with me thinking but now I am praying and continuously asking for forgiveness is any advice? Answer ID: 153842 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1251/1180/SD=11/1438) Ma-shaAllah, you have started offering salah as well as you are doing taubah, in-shaAllah you shall get relief and peace of heart. Keep on offering fardh and protect yourself from minor and major sins. Moreover, start reading some Islamic book at your home. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
